# v2.3 identity fixture (2026-10-09)

These are byte-for-byte copies of the full v2.3 NAV and the official close-confirmed latest-signal CSV generated by the microcap repository on 2026-10-09. The source whole-delivery manifest and the read-only post-signal `top100_delivery.py check` both reported `ok=true`, `errors=[]`, and `expected_date=2026-10-09`.

The NAV contains all 3,990 rows from 2010-05-05 through 2026-10-09 (5,580,804 bytes). The latest-signal file contains one 2026-10-09 row (5,125 bytes), with revision `plain_lb25_hl2p5_r2off_vol10_26_20_20260904` and `signal_timing=close_confirmed`. The strategy checkout used by the fixture-copy step is disposable; the files are copied only into its `outputs/` directory for the mandatory identity test.

`source_top100_delivery_manifest.json` is the exact accepted whole-delivery manifest. `fixture_provenance.json` records its hash, the post-signal whole-check evidence path, exact raw CSV hashes, and newline-normalized hashes used by that manifest. `.gitattributes` disables line-ending conversion for all fixture CSV and JSON bytes.
